name: session_edit_verified
description: Back up, stage, inspect, validate, commit and verify a session edit.

steps.purpose: Read the backup and session preparation guidance and follow it before editing.
Use replace with unique exact target_text and new_text, the session ID and current revision. Retain the returned revision after each successful change.
Show all staged text, paging as needed, and review every change against the request.
Validate using the latest revision. If validation or source synchronization fails, preserve the sidecar and report the conflict; do not claim success.
Commit with the current revision only after review and successful validation. Preserve evidence and report failures.
Read back the committed file and run appropriate authorized behavioral checks.

limits: Guidance only; steps are not automatically executed. Syntax validation does not establish behavioral correctness. Source conflicts must be reviewed, not silently discarded.
